# stackfall board fixture v1
# Every piece type settled exactly once, in its spawn shape, down the
# left and right of the field: one frame draws all seven in-cell designs
# side by side, with no full row and free spawn cells above them.
name: all-pieces
description: the seven tetrominoes settled once each in spawn shape, left and right columns, no full row
provenance: hand-built for T095 to capture every per-piece in-cell design in one frame; independent of any piece sequence
# 22 rows from the hidden row y=-2 down to y=19; '.' is empty and a
# letter I,O,T,S,Z,J,L settles that cell in its piece color.
